text: {"lessons":["I tend to take profits in Stock E when it is well above my average cost; I should recognize that satisfaction without letting it alone determine whether to sell.","Selling a winner in several small trades can leave me underexposed if it keeps rising, so I should consider my overall allocation and reasons for holding before trimming further.","A few periods of gains or losses do not establish a reliable strategy; I should make deliberate, diversified decisions and avoid reacting to short-term account changes."]}
